bio: If you’re looking for somewhere that reflects the essence of Mediterranean cooking, this restaurant in the El Raval district, close to MACBA (Museu d'Art Contemporani de Barcelona), is a superb option. In the open-view kitchen, with its signature Josper grill, the focus is on the evolution of gourmet cuisine and the variety of Mediterranean flavours which are showcased on an interesting à la carte (each dish is accompanied by information to explain its history) and three meticulously presented menus. Take a seat at the bar to enjoy the experience to the full....
